Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/12] Physical and mental health was evaluated by two self-assessment items from the phone questionnaire: "In general, would you say your physical health is . . ." and "What about your mental or emotional health?" with the response options (1) poor, (2) fair, (3) good, (4) very good, or (5) excellent (for more descriptive information on physical and mental health status, see Table 1).
Outcome_variable.warning: The outcome variables described are physical and mental health, not life satisfaction, positive affect, or negative affect as defined for SWB.
